name: Mandrake

bonuses.name: Power From Pain
bonuses.text: This If this Threat deals a Wound, it gains +2 bonus dice to Weapon Skill Tests until the end of its next Turn.

bonuses.name: Shrouded From Sight
bonuses.text: A Mandrake's shadowy form gives them +2 Defence.

abilities.name: From Out of the Shadows
abilities.text: The Mandrake emerges from the shadows. All opponents of the Mandrake must make a DN 2 Initiative Test or are Ambushed. Additionally, all opponents of the Mandrake must make a DN 2 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Fade Away
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Mandrake disappears into the shadows. At the start of its next Turn, the Mandrake may appear from any shadow within 1km using its BATTLECRY: From Out of the Shadows.

note: Print: Baleblast's trait list prints an empty entry ("Assault, , Rending (2), Spread"); the Power From Pain text reads "This If this Threat".
